info.title: Flightdeck API
info.description: Local-development API with the Stage 3 bounded string-list context extension. Version 2.0 replaced Stage 1 boolean GET evaluation with typed POST evaluation; this is not a production-stable external API. Signed local sessions remain demo-only. Inventory is project-scoped, with one shared flag row and ordered environment gate summaries rather than full configurations. Enabled state and typed configuration are environment-specific; metadata, archive state and flag revisions are project-wide. Publication pins project context/segment definitions. Archive/disable return the configured typed off value. Credentials grant explicit tenant contexts within one project/environment. Context and proposed configuration retain independent bounds inside a 64-KiB HTTP envelope. No context is stored as exposure or used as entitlement authorization.

localSession.name: fd_local_session
localSession.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Strict signed development session, issued only by explicit loopback development startup. Not a production authentication protocol.

evaluationBearer.description: Backend-only fd_ token, restricted to one organization/project/environment, explicit tenant grants and evaluation; only its SHA256 verifier is stored. Context traits are asserted by the trusted backend caller, not browser authority.
